name: convention-test-file-properties
description: A file an applied convention row's test-file property names is a test file, so its top level and exports are roots of the test run and what only it and the tests reference is test-support code: the vitest row's setupFiles and globalSetup each name one. A helper only such a file and a test reference is reported at the class possible as test-only, and neither the global setup's exported hook nor the members its augmentation of the runner's module declares for the tests to read is reported.
